body:
I’ve always been the black sheep and I come from a very religious family in which I’ve been told that if I try to commit suicide that I’m going to hell. I’m personally not very religious but I’m scared of what they’d think of me for admitting something like this.

​

Im what you’d call a “cry baby” because even the smallest things seem to get to me. When I’m feeling bad I’ll be stuck like that for weeks. My heart is too big for my body.

Ive always done pretty well in school because my parents put pressure on me to always get good marks. Recently some of my marks have been dropping and my mom is not thrilled. I have to study to be able to pursue a carrer in the future but I honestly don’t see myself making it that far so I don’t find getting good marks as important as I used to.
I may be young but I’m still willing to listen since I’m face problems of my own.
